Click each tab - URL updates and content area changes

stories.title: Add pillar, hook, brainstorm_session fields to ContentIdea
acceptanceCriteria: ContentIdea.pillar FK to Taxonomy (content_pillar type), nullable

ContentIdea.brainstorm_session FK to BrainstormSession, nullable

stories.title: Create Echo agent structure with state and prompts
acceptanceCriteria: EchoState TypedDict with messages, user_id, session_id, conversation_phase, content_pillars, target_platforms, brand_voice

Platform-specific guidance for Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube

stories.title: Create Echo tools (save_idea, get_pillars, generate_hooks)
acceptanceCriteria: save_idea tool creates ContentIdea with pillar, hook, session link
get_content_pillars tool returns user's available pillars
generate_hooks tool generates 3 hook variations for a topic/platform
expand_to_post tool expands a hook into full post draft

TOOLS_NEEDING_STATE set exports tools requiring state injection
errorHandling: save_idea with invalid pillar returns error dict
generate_hooks with unsupported platform returns generic hooks
testSteps: python -c "from services.agents.echo.tools import TOOLS_NEEDING_STATE; print('save_idea' in TOOLS_NEEDING_STATE)"

stories.title: Create Echo LangGraph agent with streaming
acceptanceCriteria: EchoAgent class with LangGraph StateGraph
Nodes: route, converse, save_idea

Conversation phase tracked and updated
errorHandling: Missing user returns error event

stories.title: Add Echo routing to WebSocket task handler
acceptanceCriteria: conversation_id starting with 'echo-' routes to _process_with_echo

Events: chunk (token), tool_start, tool_end, idea_suggested, complete, error
errorHandling: Echo agent errors caught and sent as error event
Timeout after 60 seconds sends timeout error event

stories.title: Create useEchoChat hook and useContentPillars hook
acceptanceCriteria: useEchoChat connects to ws://localhost:8000/ws/chat/echo-{sessionId}/

stories.title: Pass pillar and platform context through WebSocket
acceptanceCriteria: sendMessage accepts optional context object with pillarId and platforms
BrainstormChatPanel passes activePillar.id and activePlatforms to sendMessage
WebSocket message includes pillar_id and platforms fields (snake_case)

If no platforms selected, send empty array
stories.loadingState: N/A - context is sent with message
stories.notes: UI tracks activePillar and activePlatforms but never sends them to backend.

stories.title: Extract context from WebSocket and pass to Echo agent
acceptanceCriteria: ChatConsumer extracts pillar_id and platforms from incoming message
process_chat_message_task receives pillar_id and platforms as kwargs
_process_with_echo passes context to stream_echo_response
Conversation history is loaded and passed to stream_echo_response
errorHandling: Missing context fields default to None/empty list
If pillar_id not provided, pass None
If conversation history fails to load, continue with empty list
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python -c "from core.agents.tasks import _process_with_echo; print('import ok')"
validation: pillar_id must be int or None
platforms must be list of strings
stories.auth: User must be authenticated (enforced by WebSocket consumer)
stories.notes: stream_echo_response accepts pillar_id, content_pillars, target_platforms but they're not passed from task handler.

stories.title: Create EchoAgentProvider for centralized state management
acceptanceCriteria: EchoAgentProvider context with mode state: idle | brainstorm | create | schedule | review

stories.notes: Foundation for conversation-first redesign. Centralizes state that was scattered across components.
